prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with whiplash after a rear-end collision. The patient had 7 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1441; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a rear-end motor vehicle collision with complaints of neck pain, stiffness, and headache. Over seven visits, care consisted of supervised physical therapy, range-of-motion exercises, and as-needed anti-inflammatory medication. The reported injury is consistent with the mechanism and force of the collision, and the history of symptom onset aligns with the event. Examination revealed reduced cervical range of motion and paraspinal muscle tenderness, supporting a soft tissue injury to the cervical spine. Other findings, including neurological screening, motor strength, and reflexes, were within normal limits. No prior injury or treatment to the cervical region is known. Care followed a typical course, with visit frequency decreasing as symptoms improved and the patient was discharged to a home exercise program. Billed services align with the documented treatment, with no repeated or duplicate charges identified. Prognosis is good with continued self-directed rehabilitation.
